broadcast.text: A.J. Brown in New England now, and he is going to EAT. Chase and AJB through two rounds — go ahead, find a better start.

broadcast.text: Four straight running backs off the board and D1LLIGAF calmly takes the best player available. Discipline or luck? The booth is split.

broadcast.text: Chase at three. We didn't even have to think. Somewhere the anchor is pretending this was hard.

broadcast.text: RB-RB off the top and the room hands D1LLIGAF the best receiver in football at three. That's a gift-wrapped start.

broadcast.text: Slot 3 means one of the big three RBs lands in our lap. The rebuild starts with someone else's tears.
broadcast.speaker: homer

broadcast.text: Ten teams this year, folks — two owners took their ball and went home, and the waiver wire just got 20% juicier.
